title: Native Touch Inc.
description:
mobile advertising and audience data · Canada | The consumer audience data assets of a Canadian mobile advertising company: device movement records for Canadian consumers at multibillion record scale, each carrying device advertising identifiers, coordinates and IP addresses; Location ping records with device advertising identifiers, precise coordinates, carriers and IP addresses; Consumer IP geolocation tables at billion row scale mapping IP addresses to cities, postal codes, coordinates and internet providers; Live ad serving logs through October 2026 carrying consumer IP addresses, device advertising identifiers and coordinates; Device intelligence files received from the company's telecom data partner, and partner audience delivery records; The company's platform user directory with staff and client agency accounts, and its platform configuration records | [NOT PAID — EXPOSED]

Initially listed anonymously by N0n as "Company #137" on 2026-11-05.
